providers.title: API Keys
providers.description: Add your provider keys here. Cloud Speech and Post Processing then choose which of them to use.

cloudSpeech.title: Cloud Speech
cloudSpeech.description: Transcribe with a provider instead of the local model, spreading requests across your keys.

postProcess.title: Post Processing
postProcess.description: Clean up transcripts with a chat model. Each key can use its own model and its own instruction.
postProcess.templatesDescription: Write your instructions here. The one selected below is used by any key that does not pick its own.
postProcess.usingLegacyProvider: No keys listed, so cleanup still uses the {{provider}} settings from before this build. Add a key above to switch to rotation.

credentials.label: Name
credentials.secretUnchanged: Leave blank to keep the current key
credentials.baseUrlShared: Shared by every key on this provider.
credentials.noKeyNeeded: This provider runs without an API key.
credentials.deleteConfirm: Delete this key? It is also removed from your Cloud Speech and Post Processing lists.
credentials.testNote: Testing checks that a key works. It cannot confirm the key has access to a particular model.
credentials.sharedQuotaDescription: Turn on when this provider meters speech and cleanup from the same allowance, so hitting the limit in one pauses the key for both. Groq meters them separately; leave it off there.

binding.enableSttDescription: Send recordings to a provider instead of transcribing on this machine. Audio leaves your computer when this is on.
binding.keysDescription: One key per dictation, taken in this order. Drag to reorder.
binding.noKeysAtAll: No API keys yet. Add one on the API Keys page first.
binding.noEligibleKeys: None of your keys are with a provider that offers this. OpenAI, Groq and Custom endpoints do speech; any provider can do cleanup.
binding.policyDescription: Round robin walks the list in order. Least recently used picks the key idle the longest, which spreads load evenly and survives a restart.
binding.cooldownDescription: How long a key stays benched after it trips the strike threshold. Maximum 7 days.
binding.strikeThresholdDescription: Failed requests before a key is benched. A 429 carrying retry-after is honoured instead and costs no strike.
binding.fallback: Fall back to the local model
binding.fallbackDescription: When the rotation is exhausted, transcribe on this machine instead. Off surfaces the failure rather than silently degrading.
binding.languageDescription: Leave blank to let the provider detect it.
binding.languageIgnoredWhenTranslating: Not used while Translate to English is on: that mode detects the language itself.
binding.sttPromptDescription: A short list of names, jargon or acronyms the model tends to get wrong. This biases how audio is heard. Do not put instructions here.
binding.streamingConflict: Live transcription preview is turned off while cloud speech is on, because a remote provider returns the whole transcript at once rather than word by word.

entryDialog.addTitle: Add a key to the rotation
entryDialog.duplicate: This key already serves this model. Pick a different model, or edit the existing entry.

degraded.fellBackToLocal: Cloud transcription unavailable, used the local model instead.
degraded.rawTranscript: Cleanup unavailable, kept the raw transcript.

reason.not_configured: No usable key is set up for this.
reason.all_credentials_cooling_down: Every key is cooling down. None was contacted.
reason.all_credentials_failed: Every key was tried and every one failed.
reason.recording_too_large: The recording is too long to upload.
reason.timed_out: The provider took too long to answer.
